prompt: The V-shaped graph $y = |x|$ becomes $y = |x| - 4$. What is the $y$-coordinate of the point of the V?
hint: Where is the point of the parent V before anything changes? Then ask what a number outside the bars does to heights.

hints.text: Where is the point of the parent V before anything changes? Then ask what a number outside the bars does to heights.
The parent V has its point at $(0, 0)$. The $-4$ is outside the bars, so lower that point's $y$-value by $4$.
The point of the V drops from $0$ to $0 - 4 = -4$, so its $y$-coordinate is $-4$.

explanation: $|0| = 0$, so the parent V has its point at $(0, 0)$.
The new point of the V is at $(0, -4)$, so the $y$-coordinate is $-4$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Picture the sticker sliding
steps: Imagine the V is a sticker on your window.
Subtracting 4 outside means you peel it off and press it back down 4 units lower.
The tip of the V lands at $-4$ on the $y$-axis.
